metadata.notes: Manual de cócteles del Hotel Martinique (Broadway esquina con la 32, NYC). Establecimiento de gama alta de Manhattan parte de una cadena que incluía también los hoteles Gotham, Dauphin y Whitehall. 63 recetas reales rescatadas de 146 candidatas heurísticas; el resto eran fragmentos de ingredientes y publicidad. Incluye clásicos (Manhattan, Martini Dry/Sweet, Aviation —en versión Apple Jack, no la canónica con gin/violeta—, Bronx, Side Car, Ward 8, Mary Pickford, Singapore Sling) y especialidades de la casa (Old Martinique Special, Martinique Fizz). Algunas fracciones OCR (e.g., '16 Jigger' por '½ Jigger') no se han corregido automáticamente; ver raw_text para verificar. Saltadas (no son recetas reales): Fence." recipes.method_original: Place half the crushed mint and liquid in the bottom of a cracked glass tumbler, or in sterling silver or pewter tankard. Fill glass half full of finely crushed ice. Add rest of crushed mint and fill remainder of glass with crushed ice. Pour in whiskey until glass is brimming. Place in ice box for at least an hour (if possible). Decorate with sprigs of mint covered with powdered sugar when ready to serve. MINT JULEP (Georgia) 4 Sprigs Fresh Mint ½ Tablespoon Powdered Sugar
recipes.method_es: servir.
recipes.raw_text:
ORIGINAL KENTUCKY
[Recipes for fhe Mint Julep are widely dis
cussed and debated. NMe believe the following
recipe Is the original and authentic one.)
   Put 12 sprigs fresh mint in bowl, covered with
powdered sugar and just enough water to dis
solve the sugar, and crush with wooden pestle.
Place half the crushed mint and liquid in the
bottom of a cracked glass tumbler, or in sterling
silver or pewter tankard. Fill glass half full of
finely crushed ice. Add rest of crushed mint and
fill remainder of glass with crushed ice. Pour in
whiskey until glass is brimming. Place in ice box
for at least an hour (if possible). Decorate with
sprigs of mint covered with powdered sugar
when ready to serve.

          MINT JULEP (Georgia)
          4 Sprigs Fresh Mint
         1/2 Tablespoon Powdered Sugar
